name: Zillethai
overview: Zillethai is a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Shimei. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or detailed background provided beyond his lineage. This situates him within the genealogical records important for understanding the tribe of Benjamin.
namesAndTitles: The name Zillethai is a proper name meaning "shadow of YHWH." This meaning highlights a possible spiritual or symbolic significance, reflecting a connection to the presence or protection of the Lord. The name itself was not given directly by God according to the record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Zillethai is the son of Shema, as stated in 1 Chronicles 8:20. No other family relationships are documented beyond this direct paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Zillethai's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical lineage of the tribe of Benjamin. The genealogies serve to preserve the heritage and continuity of God's chosen people, emphasizing the faithfulness of God across generations. Although Zillethai himself does not have a recorded narrative or role beyond his ancestry, his inclusion supports the biblical emphasis on family lines and tribal identity.
